Changelog
[/size]3.0.0
[list]
[*]Refactored code to simplify things.
[*]Fixed config not applying properly.
[*]Added support for the Auto-grabber.
[*]There's now a chance at two different produce items.
[/list]
2.3.0
[list]
[*]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0
[/list]
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*](optional) If you want to change mod settings, you will need to then close the game and edit the config.json in the mod folder!
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.x+ on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in singleplayer and multiplayer.
[*]May be incompatibilities with other mods that modify the produce from blue chickens, please report any conflicts.
[/list]
[size=5]Support[/size]
[list]
[*]﻿If you need additional support, leave a comment or join the discord linked above!
[/list]

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/rikai/ABonafideSpecialBlueChicken]Source Code[/url]﻿

Downloads.Description:
This should correct most existing bugs and add support for the auto-grabber.

Refactored code to simplify things, Fixed config not applying properly, Added support for the Auto-grabber.

There's now a chance at two different produce items!
